title: Plan mode
line: Review the plan before edits start.

beats.caption: You ask for a plan for the new flag.
The agent can inspect files in read-only mode.
beats.label: pi-plan-mode

beats.caption: It asks how the flag should behave.
You review the work and its verification steps.
Your approval opens the way to edits.

takeaway.title: Approve the approach
takeaway.line: Read the plan and check how the agent will verify it.

title.text: A small change can hide a decision about how it should behave. Plan mode gives you time to make it.

scene.text: You ask for a flag that prints a greeting in capitals. The agent can read the project first. When it comes to a choice about the flag, it asks you. Then you can read the planned changes and the checks it will run. Approve that plan, and the agent can start editing.

takeaway.text: Use the review to settle the behaviour and how you'll check it. Then let the agent make the change.
